definitions.explanation: A deciduous tree with distinctive fan-shaped leaves that turn golden yellow in autumn. One of the oldest tree species on Earth.

examples.japanese: {銀杏|いちょう}⟦{並木|なみき}→並木：00302_namiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{黄金色|こがねいろ}→黄金色：19037_koganeiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まって→染まる：04254_somaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The ginkgo avenue is turning golden.
Ginkgo leaves have fallen on the road.
In autumn, there are people who gather ginkgo nuts.

notes:
{銀杏|いちょう} refers to ginkgo trees.

Multiple readings:
- {銀杏|いちょう} - the tree
- ⟦{銀杏|ぎんなん}→銀杏：28490_ginnan⟧ - the edible nut/seed

Common expressions:
- {銀杏|いちょう}⟦{並木|なみき}→並木：00302_namiki⟧ (ginkgo tree-lined avenue)
- {銀杏|いちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧ (ginkgo leaf)
- ⟦{銀杏|ぎんなん}→銀杏：28490_ginnan⟧ (ginkgo nut - eaten roasted or in dishes)

Counter: ⟦{本|ほん}→〜本：00688_hon⟧ (for trees)

Cultural note:
Ginkgo trees are commonly planted along streets in Japan. Famous ginkgo avenues include Meiji Jingu Gaien in Tokyo, which turns bright yellow in November. The ginkgo leaf is the symbol of Tokyo Metropolitan Government. ⟦{銀杏|ぎんなん}→銀杏：28490_ginnan⟧ (ginkgo nuts) are eaten in autumn dishes like ⟦{茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}し→茶碗蒸し：17312_chawanmushi⟧, but they have a strong smell when fresh.
